QuestInfo.name: Mr. Do's Suspicious Potion 2
QuestInfo.0: The potion did NOTHING to boost the drinker's intelligence! But Mr. Do didn't seem to agree.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Do gave Alpha and Beta and strange blue potion to drink next. Oh boy...
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta turned into a Sage Cat when they drank Mr. Do's blue potion!
